evidence.ref: .warp/dashboard.py reads .warp/events.jsonl only through .warp/metrics.py compute() and renders cycle time, proof latency, human_minutes, gate pass rate, verdict counts, emergency debt, and regression health as a text report or a self-contained HTML page (inline CSS only, no external asset/script/link/network); metrics.compute() was extended once (verdict_counts, regression_health) so the reader and the dashboard share one calculation

a selftest block builds a synthetic events stream, calls metrics.compute() and the dashboard figure function, and asserts the dashboard numbers EQUAL compute() for cycle time, human_minutes, gate pass rate, verdict counts, and regression health (no drift), plus a red-standing case proving current_gate is red when the latest gate event failed (isolating the current-gate computation); part of selftest 667 passed, 0 failed
